findings.observed: map-input-controller.test.mjs:75 EventTarget and :83 CustomEvent violate no-undef.
findings.cause: The newly added test harness references Node globals as bare identifiers not declared in the repository ESLint environment.
findings.mainComparison: New +152-line test fixture relative to main. This defect was introduced in the new regression test; it is not a production runtime regression.
findings.minimalFollowup: Use globalThis.EventTarget and globalThis.CustomEvent, or explicit destructuring from globalThis.
findings.status: Root reports both references fixed and all 18 unit tests passed; final focused lint gate is pending. This triage did not re-run or re-read the subsequent fix.

findings.observed: river-territory-partition-source.test.mjs fails at module import: readFileSync is not defined.
findings.cause: The test imports fs as a default but calls bare readFileSync at line 7. Its next two reads also still use retired assets/js source locations.
findings.mainComparison: Test blob f40e66ea0ce8c58e5895234a7f27419af73a2579 is identical on both commits. ReferenceError occurs before those production files are read.
findings.minimalFollowup: Correct the fs import/use and move renderer/worker reads to the canonical shared/frontend source owner. Preserve the existing partition assertions.
findings.unverified: Subsequent regexp assertions and the latent old-path failures were not executed.

findings.observed: Three failures expect createResourceSnapshot, MANIFEST_URL.searchParams.set('v', DATA_REVISION), and an inline canonicalCountryStore port mapping in the foundation module.
findings.cause: The manifest loader now consumes pinned buildMeta.worldBundle through manifestLoader.loadAsset/parseVerifiedWorldBundle. The exact canonicalCountryStore mapping exists in shared map-owner-ports.js rather than inline in foundation. The createResourceSnapshot search on immutable main returned only the stale test reference; no production owner was confirmed for that symbol.
findings.mainComparison: Test identical on both commits. data-loader-worker.js, foundation port module, and shared map-owner-ports.js unchanged in the complete compare. gpu-map-renderer.js, gpu-scene.js, and map-content-presentation.js do have branch changes, so this report does not certify all rendering behavior as unchanged.
findings.minimalFollowup: Replace obsolete symbol/file-location checks with checks against the current owner or observable frame/resource behavior. Keep revision separation and immutable manifest verification coverage.
findings.unverified: Actual startup/render performance and the replacement for the retired snapshot symbol were not traced or executed; no performance-regression pass claim.

findings.observed: Lifecycle assembly test fails with 'Map input requires its operation error reporter.'
findings.cause: capabilityPortsForFixture returns flatDependencies[property]. The lifecycle test's flat overrides omit reportOperationError, leaving ports.feedback.reportOperationError undefined when real map presentation is constructed.
findings.mainComparison: Test, capability fixture helper, and app-lifecycle-assembly are unchanged. map-input-presentation differs only by the viewer cancelStroke guard; its required reporter validation is unchanged.
findings.minimalFollowup: Provide a real operation-error recorder/handler in the fixture while preserving the strict production requirement and lifecycle/Escape assertions.
findings.unverified: The entire real editor composition graph was not rerun in this triage.

findings.observed: Six label-input cases fail because dependencies.objectOperationsA.objectRefVisible is not a function.
findings.cause: Fixture objectOperationsA contains only objectDisplayInfo. Unchanged object-picking.js requires objectRefVisible at line 36 before label selection. The production foundation map exposes objectRefVisible from objectCommands; the current objectCommands obtains it from createObjectQuery.
findings.mainComparison: Test, object-picking.js, and foundation port mapping unchanged. app-object-commands.js has branch changes (+39/-16), so complete object-command behavior is not claimed identical.
findings.minimalFollowup: Wire the fixture's visibility dependency using the current object-query/visibility contract; preserve hidden-object, explicit label identity, blocking, modifier, and placement assertions.
findings.unverified: No label cases were rerun, and later failures after the missing dependency are not excluded.

findings.observed: Three cases expect successful admission/integrity/capability checks but receive PL-CORE-PREREQUISITE-MISSING for shared/frontend/static/wasm/pandoeditor-core.manifest.json.
findings.cause: The fixture writes under root/assets/wasm; the current loader reads frontendWasmRoot = shared/frontend/static/wasm.
findings.mainComparison: Test identical; tools/load-node-core.mjs and scripts/lib/frontend-layout.mjs unchanged in complete compare.
findings.minimalFollowup: Use frontendWasmRoot in the synthetic fixture and make shared-directory setup idempotent or order it before creating nested assets. Retain missing/integrity/stale/capability expectations.
findings.unverified: No synthetic prerequisite tests or native/WASM builds were run.

findings.observed: Fixed separate Worker-entry test fails with Missing immutable Worker asset for /shared/frontend/js/workers/core-viewer-session-worker.js.
findings.cause: The test directly imports source and replaces global Worker but does not supply a generated frontend/immutable worker metadata context. workerAssetUrl intentionally recognizes the deployed /assets/js/ namespace; the source file URL does not provide that key.
findings.mainComparison: Test and worker-asset-url.js unchanged. core-document-client.js changed for temporal operations (+48/-6), but its default Worker factory precedes the changed hunks and is unchanged.
findings.minimalFollowup: Exercise the real default client factory from the generated frontend fixture with valid immutable Worker metadata. Do not add a production fallback or merely replace the factory while asserting fake URLs.
findings.unverified: No Worker/bootstrap test rerun; actual generated build behavior not independently reverified here.

findings.observed: CSS selector contract fails with Unclassified product change: assets/css/features/map-rendering.css.
findings.cause: The fixture supplies deployed URL paths as repository changed-file paths. Canonical source paths are shared/frontend/css/features/map-rendering.css and shared/frontend/js/workers/canvas-render-worker.js.
findings.mainComparison: Test and plan-application-checks.mjs unchanged. Catalog changed only deferred/manual registrations in the inspected diff, not these source owner mappings.
findings.minimalFollowup: Update fixture changedFiles to source-owned paths; preserve expected UI/browser selection and absence of native/GIS generation.
findings.unverified: The application selector was not run.
